source.licenseBoundary: No LICENSE or COPYING file was present at the audited repository commit. This artifact reports aggregate field counts only and does not redistribute source data or code.

scope: Structural audit of the public YBCO example for prospective policy replay and causal off-policy evaluation.
adjudicationBoundary: Experimentally Verified is a dataset field, not a record of blinded independent outcome adjudication. Rows marked false are not counted as independently executed failures.
conclusion: The example supports retrospective route-outcome and measurement-field analyses. It does not support chronological policy replay or causal comparison of search policies without an additional event ledger or prospectively logged campaign.
